entries.fb53e7fb670e541c: As a dedicated semiconductor manufacturer, it conducts research, development, design, manufacturing, sales and services for various semiconductors. These functions are divided between Renesas itself and its subsidiaries: research, development and design are handled by Renesas as well as overseas subsidiaries such as Renesas Electronics America, Inc. and Renesas Design Vietnam Co., Ltd., manufacturing is handled mainly by production subsidiaries in Japan and overseas, and external production contractors such as [[term:foundry|foundries]] are also used as needed. In Japan, it sells mainly through affiliated authorized distributors, and overseas mainly through overseas sales subsidiaries and distributors.
